provenance: Built from the live site only (34 sitemap pages, S1-S9 on 2026-10-25) and the source repo's design-system v3 docs; it uses no output from any migration work. Judged by the Track B (site-scope) context, which ran extract and spec only and never opened blocks/, styles/, scripts/, head.html, stardust/first-page/ or stardust/replica/. S5 (real-user data) skipped: no RUM domain key.

features.name: Light / Dark / System theme control
features.evidence: header .theme-control on 34/34; head inline script reads localStorage jj-theme before first paint; js/site.js toggles data-theme and listens to prefers-color-scheme and storage events
features.eds: head.html inline pre-paint script (no flash) + header block tools section; styles carry both themes from the v3 tokens
decisions: Keep the jj-theme key so returning visitors keep their choice

features.name: Header Menu drawer below 1024px
features.evidence: chrome-explore 390: one drawer control (Menu/Close), 4 links + 3 theme buttons in the panel; none at 1440

features.name: Ambient canvas hero art
features.evidence: js/page-art.js draws canvas.ambient-art in .graphic-hero on home, writing, talks, certifications; rAF about 30 fps, paused off-screen and when hidden, still frame under reduced motion
features.eds: hero block JS (variants home, hub), loaded after LCP so it never delays it
decisions: Port page-art.js as-is (signature) or replace it with a static frame; replica keeps it

features.name: Writing index list
features.evidence: /writing/ lists 28 article rows (cover, date, title, summary, topic chips, facts) authored by hand; data-date, data-topics, data-search attributes per row
decisions: Topics (aem, ai-engineering) and cover image become page metadata

features.name: Writing filter and search
features.evidence: js/writing-filter.js: topic and year pills with counts, text search over data-search; state in the URL hash (#q=, #topic=, #year=); form GET /writing/?q= as the no-JS fallback
features.eds: widget writing-filter filtering the writing-list rows; keep the hash keys so shared links work

features.name: Interactive article explainers and labs
features.evidence: explainer roots on 21 articles and .lab frames on 13 (27 of 28 articles in all); 26 articles load a local explainer.css and most a script; controls without a form tag (dynamics F finding: form-less control group)
features.eds: explainer and lab blocks; per-article code (see open question explainer-build)
decisions: Block variant per explainer, or a code-only widget per explainer

features.name: Article rail progress and current part
YouTube embeds
features.evidence: youtube-nocookie iframes on 19 pages (20 embeds); one click-to-load facade on the portfolio
features.eds: video block (nocookie host, lazy facade so the iframe never blocks LCP)
decisions: Use a facade everywhere for Lighthouse 100, or keep direct iframes

features.name: Figure zoom and open-file lightbox
features.evidence: dynamics: lightbox-zoom and lightbox-file triggers (portfolio lb-zoomable x7, one article fig--zoom)

features.name: Portfolio interactions
features.evidence: portfolio/script.js (26 KB): carousel, diagram deck tabs, Gantt now-marker, counters, glossary chips, reveal-on-scroll, video facade
features.eds: carousel, tabs, timeline, stats, explainer blocks
decisions: Reveal-on-scroll must not hide content without JS (canon rule)

features.name: Google tag (GA4 G-ZVENE6BXTJ)
features.evidence: gtag.js?id=G-ZVENE6BXTJ async + inline dataLayer/gtag config on 34/34; 540 KB library; no consent mode defaults
features.eds: scripts/delayed.js loads gtag after 3 s (keeps Lighthouse 100); same property id
decisions: Same GA4 property for EDS hosts
Keep loading without a consent banner, as today

features.name: Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon and RUM
features.evidence: static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js and POST /cdn-cgi/rum on 34/34, injected at the Cloudflare zone
features.eds: nothing in code: keeps working when Cloudflare proxies the EDS origin with automatic injection on; EDS adds its own RUM
decisions: Keep Cloudflare Web Analytics beside EDS RUM, or drop it

features.name: Cloudflare email obfuscation rewriting article text
features.evidence: server HTML of 3 articles links /cdn-cgi/l/email-protection (S4: 404 when fetched); Cloudflare Scrape Shield rewrites email-like strings, including ones inside code samples
features.eds: Cloudflare keeps rewriting unless the zone setting changes; recommendation: turn email obfuscation off for www so authored text and code render verbatim
decisions: Disable Scrape Shield email obfuscation on www (owner decision; not decided-out until the owner states it)

features.name: Hotlinked certification badge images
features.evidence: 22 badge images from images.credly.com and learn.microsoft.com on /certifications/
features.eds: keep hotlinks, or copy the badges into the EDS media bus for speed and stability

open_questions.question: Are the GitHub Pages project sites linked from in-scope pages part of this migration?
open_questions.context: Articles link 4 same-host project sites (/ai-sandbox/, /bruce-hackathon-2026-09-12/, /bruce-lava-dash/, /bruce-play-ten/); 3 more (/adapt-to-2026-demo/, /denison-2026-04-24/, /harness-v2-test/) share the host unlinked. The brief keeps all 7 on GitHub Pages under Cloudflare.
options: No: they stay on GitHub Pages, routed by Cloudflare
Yes: migrate them too
open_questions.default: No: they stay on GitHub Pages; Cloudflare routes their prefixes away from EDS.

open_questions.question: Is the EDS URL format accepted, with redirects for every changed path?
open_questions.context: Every page is a folder URL with a trailing slash today. EDS serves /writing/<slug> unless each page is authored as an index document; external links and search results point at the slash form.
options: Author every page as <path>/index so the slash URLs stay
Drop the trailing slash and redirect each old URL
Mix: keep slash for hubs, drop for articles
open_questions.default: Author every page as <path>/index so the slash URLs stay and no redirect is needed.

open_questions.question: Do the EDS hosts use the same GA4 property (G-ZVENE6BXTJ)?
open_questions.context: One gtag property on 34/34 pages, loaded async today. EDS loads it in the delayed phase to keep Lighthouse 100.
options: Same property, delayed load
New property for EDS
open_questions.default: Same property, delayed load; .aem.page and .aem.live hosts filtered in GA.

open_questions.question: Should the migration add a consent banner or Google Consent Mode?
open_questions.context: No CMP and no consent defaults today; gtag and the Cloudflare beacon load unconditionally.
options: Keep as today (no banner)
Add Consent Mode defaults (denied until choice)
Add a CMP
open_questions.default: Keep as today; the replica changes nothing the visitor sees.

open_questions.question: Where do the images live after cutover?
open_questions.context: Every image is a file in the GitHub Pages repo (article images/, portfolio/assets/, /assets/) and the project sites keep serving from GitHub Pages. Badges are hotlinked from Credly and Microsoft.
options: Upload all images to DA (EDS media bus)
Keep them on GitHub Pages and link absolute URLs
DA for page images, hotlinks kept for badges
open_questions.default: Upload page images to DA so EDS optimizes them; keep badge hotlinks until a later pass.

open_questions.question: Is the client-side writing filter over the query index enough, or is full-text search required?
open_questions.context: Today the filter matches words in each row's data-search text (title, summary, topics), not the article body.
options: Client filter over the query index (title, description, topics)
Full-text search service
open_questions.default: Client filter over the query index, matching today's behavior.

open_questions.question: Which CDN fronts the EDS site in production?
open_questions.context: Cloudflare fronts www today and must keep routing the 7 GitHub Pages project sites under the same host.
options: Cloudflare in front of EDS (BYO CDN) with path routing
Adobe-managed CDN
open_questions.default: Cloudflare in front of EDS with path routing (README decision).

open_questions.question: Who sets the security headers (CSP, HSTS, permissions policy) on the new stack?
open_questions.context: The source HTML ships none. EDS supports a header config; Cloudflare can add them at the edge.
options: EDS headers config
Cloudflare transform rules
Leave as today
open_questions.default: EDS headers config, so the policy lives with the code.

open_questions.question: Are the portfolio story media blocks (frame, diagram deck, carousel, ladder, stat chips, flow) authored as adjacent blocks or fragments?
open_questions.context: EDS blocks do not nest; 8 portfolio stories hold another block in their media column.
options: Adjacent blocks in the same section, showcase reads the next block as its media
Fragments referenced from the showcase media cell
open_questions.default: Adjacent blocks in the same section.

open_questions.question: Is the target pixel parity, or consolidation onto a shared design system?
open_questions.context: The plan runs the replica flow on design system v3: near pixel-perfect, changes only through the inconsistency register.
options: Pixel parity (replica)
Consolidate onto the design system
open_questions.default: Pixel parity (replica), with register entries for the off-ladder breakpoints, radii and the portfolio 1200px cap.

open_questions.question: How are the bespoke article explainers built on EDS?
open_questions.context: 27 of 28 articles carry interactive explainers or labs (32 explainer roots on 21 articles, 30 labs on 13), most with their own CSS and script. Their copy is authored prose and tables; their behavior is per article.
options: One explainer block, one variant (CSS + JS file) per explainer, rows authored in DA
A code-only widget per explainer with its copy in the widget HTML
Ship the settled DOM as an embed fragment per article
open_questions.default: One explainer block with a variant per explainer, rows authored in DA, so authors keep the copy.

open_questions.question: Are code blocks carried with their pre-highlighted token spans, or authored as plain code and highlighted on the client?
open_questions.context: 45 code blocks on 18 articles use tk-k, tk-s, tk-n, tk-c spans and line numbers. DA keeps code text but not span classes.
options: Plain code in DA, client highlighter in the code block (pixel check against the spans)
Carry the spans as HTML in the code block cell
open_questions.default: Plain code in DA plus a small client highlighter tuned to the four token classes.

open_questions.question: Are the paragraph-level patterns (facts, watch chapters, byline) blocks or auto-blocked from metadata?
open_questions.context: p.article-facts on 28 articles, p.watch on 17, the byline on 28; DA authors cannot class a paragraph.
options: facts and chapters blocks, byline from metadata
All three from metadata and auto-blocking
open_questions.default: facts and chapters as small blocks, the byline built from page metadata in the article hero.

open_questions.question: Is the author box one shared fragment?
open_questions.context: Identical author box copy on 28 articles.
options: One fragment referenced by every article (or auto-blocked)
Copy per article
open_questions.default: One fragment, auto-inserted on article pages.

open_questions.question: Should Cloudflare email obfuscation stay on for www?
open_questions.context: It rewrites email-like strings on 3 articles (code samples included) into /cdn-cgi/l/email-protection links that 404 without its script.
options: Turn it off for the EDS routes
Keep it
open_questions.default: Turn it off so authored text and code render verbatim.
